mapper.select: SELECT cm.id, cm.from_user_id AS fromUserId, cm.to_user_id AS toUserId, cm.content, cm.type, cm.is_read AS isRead, cm.create_time AS createTime, fu.nickname AS fromUserNickname, fu.avatar AS fromUserAvatar, tu.nickname AS toUserNickname, tu.avatar AS toUserAvatar FROM chat_message cm LEFT JOIN sys_user fu ON cm.from_user_id = fu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON cm.to_user_id = tu.id WHERE (cm.from_user_id = #{me} AND cm.to_user_id = #{other}) OR (cm.from_user_id = #{other} AND cm.to_user_id = #{me}) ORDER BY cm.create_time ASC
